# Ailton Rocha

> Threat Hunter & Detection Engineer in São Paulo, Brazil: Blue Team with an offensive foundation, working across defense, offense and AI. In security since 2014, with hands-on reverse engineering knowledge. Hypothesis-driven threat hunting with MITRE ATT&CK and TaHiTI; production detections on CrowdStrike (CQL), Cortex XDR and Splunk (SPL); autonomous AI agents for SecOps; Purple Team with Breach and Attack Simulation; incident response and CTI. Measured impact: 90% fewer false positives after detection tuning, 62 of 62 AI triage closures confirmed in blind review, 60% less manual triage after automation, continuous hunting across 50K+ endpoints. Credentials: 11 certifications, including eCTHP, eCIR, DCPT and 4 Hack The Box Pro Labs. Creator of knowledge-rag, an open-source AI project with 28K+ downloads. Also known as Lyon (lyonzin).
